answer: We design a Sybil-resistant protocol deploying dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices to penalize forgery. By anchoring capital barriers to escrowed reserves, an attacker cultivating a malicious grove of synthetic accounts faces a strictly negative expected payoff, plunging resources into a downward spiral. Consequently, this architecture forces rational adversarial agents to converge toward a strict Nash equilibrium, safeguarding the canonical garden from collusion.
